mission.title: Denial of Service
mission.description: Stop Zion's attempts to contact the intruder and defend the System's jamming stations.

npc.say:
Ah, {player}. Tell me, do you ever feel a...longing for your previous life as a citizen within the simulation?
Mm-hm... I see...
Well. Thank you for your time.
Thank you. No further data is required at this time.

Ah, yes... Agent Gray was referring to certain conversations System representatives held with the intruder before he entered the Matrix. Naturalmente, these are classified, although it is no secret that he has decided to disobey System protocols.
The operative is attempting to communicate with me. Please advise.

Oh, well, I haven't got all day to sit around and play phone tag, hon. I've got to get outside...
You just think about what I said, hm? There's a dear.

phase.briefing:
Operative, as our attempts to remove the intruder by the direct application of force have proven singularly unsuccessful, we are designating you to occupy yourself with a more manageable target: terrorists. Hostile parties, most particularly Zion and E Pluribus Neo, have been attempting to contact the intruder, likely in an attempt to win him over to their side. Obviously, this would not be advantageous to us.
Fortunately, their means of locating the intruder are much more limited than ours. They must move openly, which allows us, in turn, to locate them. Terrorist activity has been detected at the location indicated. You are to nullify all hostile parties you find there.

enter.say: I've got unauthorized redpill signals in there. They're all yours.

Hey, am I the only one who finds it pretty weird that we can't do anything to this guy? I mean, not even a signal lock or a kill code or something? What's he got that the Machines can't deal with? It's their damn simulation.

done.say:
Man, that self-serving pretentiousness really gets on my nerves, you know?
All right, let's see if Gray has any more terrorists that need nullifying.

phase.briefing:
Zion is making a significant effort to contact the intruder. We have detected transmissions from them on the broadcast channel he uses. He has...shown a reluctance to conduct further dialogue with us, but we certainly do not want Zion using that channel to try to speak to him themselves.
We have installations equipped to jam local terrorist broadcasts. I am sending you to one of these stations now. You will contact Agent Pace, who is awaiting your arrival.

enter.say: Jeez, I'm getting a lot of static myself. The jamming station should be in there. They must be pumping a lot of power into that thing.

talk.say: Saluti, operative. Fritz Sharma and Ricardo Magnor are at your disposal. They should be more than sufficient for the Zionite force you are expected to encounter.

done.say: Go ahead and grab those two.

objective.text: Lead Fritz Sharma and Ricardo Magnor out of the area

phase.briefing: A group of Zionites has attempted to send a message to the intruder by hacking a telephone at the location indicated. They were unsuccessful, but as a necessary precaution, we would like them forcibly removed from the simulation.

enter.say:
I wonder if you can get "forcible" and "removal" tattooed on your knuckles?
Let's see... Yep, I've got 'em. Go on and take away their phone privileges.

done.say:
Not too shabby.
Ah, I'm getting a call from Gray. You'd better head outside while I patch him through.

phase.briefing: One of our jamming stations has come under attack by Zionite forces. It is important that the station remains operational. Proceed to the area, and repel the attackers.

enter.say: That's the station. The jammers are making it hard to tell what's going on in there, but I think I see some unregistered signals.

done.say: Looks like that's all of them. Better check on Veil.

talk.say:
Looks like it was a good thing I happened to be stopping by, eh, dearie?
There's quite a stir about the mystery man. The Machines are being awfully quiet about him, don't you think? Obviously, they know something... But here he is, stomping around the city, shocking people out of their PJs, and what's the System doing about it? Guarding their phones?

done.say: Hmph. She may have a point, but she'd do better to keep her nose out of our business.

mission.finish:
Jamming stations across the city have been under attack. Although the attacks have been repelled, we cannot be certain that Zion has not managed to get a signal through to the intruder. They must be prevented from carrying on open communication with him.
Your assistance has been appreciated, {player}. We will have further use for your services after the usual recuperation period.
